question: Sine bars are used when a high degree of accuracy of less than ______ is required for angle measurement.
solution:
The correct answer is __1 minute****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sine bars__ are precision tools used for measuring angles.
 
• Sine bars are employed when a high degree of accuracy of less than 1 minute is required.
 
• They function based on the principle of a sine ratio to determine angles.
 
• Typically, they are used in conjunction with slip gauges to achieve precise measurements.
 
• Sine bars are commonly used in engineering workshops for inspecting and setting angles.
 
• They ensure accuracy and reliability in angular measurements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Slip Gauges:**
 
 
• Slip gauges are precision measuring instruments used to calibrate tools and equipment.
 
• They are used in conjunction with sine bars for angular measurements.
 
 
 
• **Angle Measurement Tools:**
 
 
• Other tools for angle measurement include bevel protractors and autocollimators.
 
• These tools are used for applications requiring varying levels of precision.
